# @babel/plugin-syntax-top-level-await

> Allow parsing of top-level await in modules

See our website [@babel/plugin-syntax-top-level-await](https://babeljs.io/docs/en/babel-plugin-syntax-top-level-await) for more information.

## Install

Using npm:

```sh
npm install --save-prod @babel/plugin-syntax-top-level-await
```

or using yarn:

```sh
yarn add @babel/plugin-syntax-top-level-await --prod
```
